problem.text: Existing presets expose individual sampling policies; this change adds one constructor combining history penalties, temperature and probability filters.

reasoning.text: ComboSampler delegates to CustomSampler rather than duplicating sampling execution. Its fixed order is repetition penalty, presence/frequency penalties, optional early temperature, min-p, top-k, top-p, optional late temperature, then categorical sampling.

impact.text: Adding the class resolves the existing sampler-package import of an undefined ComboSampler. It does not make default construction successful: min_p=0.0 violates SS_MinP's constructor assertion.

source_notes.text: The parent annotation identified the missing ComboSampler export target. The new definition removes that specific inherited problem.

Reviewed discussions report separate problems: #7, “quantizing model: undefined symbol: __cxa_call_terminate”; #15, “`cogito-v1-preview-qwen-32B` generates incoherent output for bpw <= 2.5”; and #21, “Build Failure on Windows: CUDA 12.4 / PyTorch 2.7.0+cu126 / VS 2022”. None identifies ComboSampler as its subject.

limitations: Repository imports, tensor operations and CUDA sampling were not executed. The scalar calculation models filter mathematics, not GPU precision or sampling quality.
Whole-parent-tree literal search found only the ComboSampler export, not construction sites; external callers are unexamined.

claims.text: temp_last chooses whether temperature changes filter selection or only reweights surviving candidates. SS_Temperature divides logits by temperature or raises probabilities to its reciprocal; SS_MinP compares against the maximum probability times min_p, SS_TopK retains sorted leading entries, and SS_TopP normalizes and sorts before applying its cumulative-probability mask.

A scalar illustration with probabilities [0.6, 0.3, 0.1], temperature 0.5 and min_p 0.3 retained only candidate 0 with early temperature, versus candidates 0 and 1 with late temperature. This demonstrates why placement is behaviorally meaningful.

Both penalty stages share the sustain and decay arguments. Their documented meanings are a recent full-strength window and an older fading window; int(10e7) is a finite 100,000,000-token sustain default, with zero decay.

Neutral repetition, presence/frequency and temperature settings select SS_NoOp; top_k below one and top_p equal to one also do so. CustomSampler inserts preparation steps and executes the resulting state transformations. However, it records history requirements before no-op substitution, so a successfully constructed ComboSampler requests past IDs even when its penalties are neutral.

The convenience interface trades arbitrary step ordering for named parameters. CustomSampler remains the alternative for explicitly chosen ordering; existing CategoricalSampler and TopPSampler also retain explicit zero-temperature argmax branches that ComboSampler does not add.

findings.description: The new preset's default min_p conflicts with the existing step constructor, contradicting its comment that default parameters become no-ops.
findings.trigger: Construct ComboSampler() or omit min_p with Python assertions enabled.
findings.expected_behavior: Neutral defaults construct a sampler with min-p filtering disabled.
findings.actual_behavior: Stack construction calls SS_MinP(0.0), whose assertion requires 0.0 < min_p <= 1.0. AssertionError occurs before CustomSampler initialization; SS_MinP also supplies no no-op alternative. The parent-tree search finds only the package export, so reach is established for callers choosing the new constructor, not every generation workflow.

verification.description: Compared the new default and unconditional step construction with SS_MinP's assertion and searched the whole parent tree for ComboSampler references.
verification.limits: No repository constructor or package import was executed.

verification.description: Evaluated the constructor's scalar predicate at the new default; it returned False.
verification.limits: Checks the predicate only, not repository execution.

annotation.summary: Adds ComboSampler with ordered penalties and filters and configurable temperature placement, resolving a missing export target but introducing an unusable min_p default.

argv:
import math
min_p=0.0
print('default_min_p_satisfies_constructor_assertion:',0.0 < min_p <= 1.0)
print('sustain_tokens:',int(10e7))
p=[0.6,0.3,0.1]; t=0.5; m=0.3
q=[x**(1/t) for x in p]; q=[x/sum(q) for x in q]
print('min_p survivors temperature-first:',[i for i,x in enumerate(q) if x>=max(q)*m])
print('min_p survivors temperature-last:',[i for i,x in enumerate(p) if x>=max(p)*m])
